cands.name: Daniel McDow
cands.bio: Democrat, 66. Small-business owner and entrepreneur; former West Melbourne City Council member. Priorities: lower insurance costs, Medicaid expansion, teacher pay, utility rates, abortion rights.
cands.local_ties: Has lived in the area since 2010 (campaign site); home town not stated.

record.text: Former West Melbourne City Council member who says he voted four years in a row to lower property taxes.

endorsements.text: Listed on his site: Florida AFL-CIO, Florida Education Association, Brevard Federation of Teachers, IBEW Local 606, Sierra Club, Florida State Council of Machinists and other groups.

cands.gaps: Council service years and donors not found. Ballotpedia headshot exists under "Daniel McDow" but identity was not confirmed; campaign photo used. cands.name: Monique Miller
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, 56. Cybersecurity and IT executive; Moms for Liberty affiliate. Born in Kansas City; MBA from Emory. HD 33 representative since Nov 2024; on Ways & Means.

record.text: Sponsored HJR 201, a property tax amendment resolution that did not pass.
Member of the House Ways & Means Committee; succeeded Randy Fine.

cands.gaps: Sources differ on her current Moms for Liberty role (national board member per ClickOrlando; former advisory board member per Wikipedia). Donors and endorsements not found. Owner-source check was limited: the alexjoneslive.com site search was run for this name and returned no results. stewpeters.com, rumble.com and infowars.com searches were blocked (HTTP 403) and the shared web-search quota was exhausted, so those were NOT checked.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
